Eye-opening findings in Sanxingdui
The pearl of Hangzhou
My trip to Sanxingdui was great! In the
Sanxingdui Museum, I saw strange masks, the
"big guy" statue and a life-size "fruit" tree.
Some thought people from Sanxingdui were
aliens. But it's not true. Maybe they ate hotpot
three thousand years ago, just like we do today.
(Chen Li, history teacher)
I visited the West Lake last
autumn. On the f irst night, my
friends and I watched the moon
rising from a boat on the lake. We
ate mooncakes and drank Longjing
tea. The next day we walked along
the lake. It was such a nice trip.
(Jessica, nurse)
Reading timeReading time
12
An unusual "table"
A magical island
On Easter Island, I saw huge
statues called Moai. The Rapa Nui
people made them hundreds of
years ago. I loved the food on the
island. The locals cooked fresh
food on rocks! We had fish. It was
so delicious!
(Lucy, 10-year-old student)
I climbed many mountains on my trips, but Table Mountain
in South Africa was a special one. Its name comes from its top.
It is flat like a table! But it only looks flat from one side.
I went to the top by cable car. The first cable car opened in
1929. The view was so amazing!
(William, mountain lover)
